messages.text:
You are in a library. To the west there is a bookcase. To the north there is a solid door. You can see Inspector Lestrade, Chief Constable Straker and a bloodstained sofa. Inspector Lestrade is carrying some money. On the bloodstained sofa there is a body.
 Watson enters.
 Chief Constable Straker closes the solid door.

Inspector Lestrade examines the body.
 Chief Constable Straker remarks to Inspector Lestrade" Mrs Jones was a widow, her husband having died about eight years ago. At the time she came here to live near her lifelong friend Mrs Brown.".
